content:
**The Fact Finder** is a non-automatic pistol in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Steel Dawn* update.

This unique variant of the .44 pistol has the two-shot, explosive, and reduced AP cost legendary effects.

The Fact Finder is obtained as a reward for the Mother of Invention quest in the update *Steel Dawn*.

The Fact Finder was formerly known as The Troubleshooter until a Public Test Server update changed it to its current name.
